ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا
ayahs.translation_en: And when Musa said to his servant, 'I will not cease until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا
ayahs.translation_en: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَاهُ آتِنَا غَدَاءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبًا
ayahs.translation_en: So when they had passed beyond it, he said to his servant, 'Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this journey of ours much fatigue.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Did you see when we took refuge on the rock? Indeed, I forgot the fish, and none but Satan made me forget to mention it.'

ayahs.arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَا آتَيْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًا
ayahs.translation_en: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Our knowledge.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَهُ مُوسَىٰ هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا
ayahs.translation_en: Musa said to him, 'May I follow you so that you may teach me of what you have been taught of guidance?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Indeed, you will not be able to have patience with me.'

ayahs.arabic: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: 'And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَا أَعْصِي لَكَ أَمْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in any order.'

ayahs.arabic: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي السَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا
ayahs.translation_en: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, he tore it open. Musa said, 'Have you torn it open to drown its people?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Did I not say that you would not be able to have patience with me?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِي مِنْ أَمْرِي عُسْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Do not blame me for what I forgot, and do not overburden me in my affair with hardship.'

ayahs.arabic: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَامًا فَقَتَلَهُ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ
ayahs.translation_en: So they set out, until when they met a boy, he killed him. Musa said, 'Have you killed a pure soul for other than a soul?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Did I not tell you that you would not be able to have patience with me?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَيْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَاحِبْنِي ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّي عُذْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'If I ask you about anything after this, do not keep me as a companion. You have already reached from me a justification.'

ayahs.arabic: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ
ayahs.translation_en: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, and he repaired it.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.'

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَاكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَاءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا
ayahs.translation_en: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every ship by force.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا الْغُلَامُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَا أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرَدْنَا أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهُ زَكَاةً وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًا
ayahs.translation_en: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَامَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا
ayahs.translation_en: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous.
